publisher: Derived in-project from dated public assets; no new publisher claim.
license: Same as the inputs; each asset keeps its own terms.
note: Flood-risk classes and station inventories are official reference mappings, not live observations. Green-space area is computed from published polygon geometry and is not a publisher-declared total. Derived figures are marked derived and are not new official claims.

green.unit: hectares, derived from published polygon geometry

pantauBanjir.reasonId: Portal tidak merespons pada pemeriksaan 11 Oktober 2026 (HTTP dan HTTPS, batas 45 detik). Pembacaan tinggi air langsung tidak diimpor; bukan petunjuk tidak ada banjir.
pantauBanjir.reasonEn: Portal did not respond on 11 October 2026 (HTTP and HTTPS, 45 s limit). Live water-level readings are not imported; this is not a no-flood reading.

petaBencanaGauges.reasonId: Endpoint gauge PetaBencana mengembalikan topologi kosong pada pemeriksaan; tidak ada data pamantauan.
petaBencanaGauges.reasonEn: The PetaBencana floodgauges endpoint returned an empty topology when checked; no gauge observations.

tide.reasonId: Halaman pasut resmi BIG untuk stasiun Indonesia; umpan mesin belum terverifikasi, hanya tautan.
tide.reasonEn: Official BIG tide page for Indonesian stations; no machine feed verified, link only.

coverage.caveat: A neighbourhood with no published asset in this inventory is not a cleared neighbourhood. The inventory is what the publisher publishes as of the checked date, not a survey of what exists. AWLR and ARR records publish a city and an address but no neighbourhood, so they are counted per borough and never attributed to a neighbourhood by inference. A null floodgate count means the publisher published no borough for those records, not that the borough has none.

sources.measured: A height tagged on the building record.
sources.landmark: A published height for a named landmark outline.
sources.google: Satellite-derived height for this individual footprint, 2023.
sources.floors: Floor count multiplied by 3.3 m; the count is observed, the per-floor height is assumed.
sources.ghsl: Built-up height averaged over the surrounding 100 m cell, 2018; not this building.
sources.estimated: A default for this building type; no measurement and no satellite signal.

confidence.caveat: Confidence in the height, not in the footprint. Every building carries its own source; none is silently promoted to a measurement.
